summary: iter199 Panel del Mensajero (Fase 2) frontend e2e — ALL 6 requested flows PASS after fixing one critical crash. Bug found: services/deliveries.py::_ref_display stored the entire withdrawal.details dict as delivery.address, causing React to throw 'Objects are not valid as a React child' on both /dashboard/deliveries (CourierPanel) and /admin/deliveries (AdminDeliveries) — the whole screen crashed with 'Algo salió mal'. Fixed in-place (see updated_files) and re-verified full flow.

critical.issue: Was setting delivery.address = ref.get('details') (a dict) instead of details.get('address') (a string). Any delivery auto-created from a cash withdrawal broke both frontend pages that render {d.address}. FIXED in this iteration + migrated one existing broken doc; recommend main agent add a regression test for the withdrawal-kind branch (pytest 7/7 only covered the redemption branch).

minor.issue: Cancelling a delivery whose parent withdrawal has an active courier-fee charge does NOT refund the fee to the client (VIP was left 2660 CUP short after we cancelled a 3 USDT delivery). Consider auto-triggering courier-fee km=0 on cancel, or documenting the workflow.

CourierPanel and AdminDeliveries do not have Error Boundary fallback beyond the top-level app boundary — a single malformed row takes the whole page down. Consider wrapping the delivery cards/table in a smaller boundary or defensive String() coercion on d.address/d.province.

rca_of_the_issue: Cause: In services/deliveries.py::_ref_display, the withdrawal branch used `ref.get('details') or ''` which returns the full details dict {receiver_name, receiver_id, phone, address, province} instead of just the address string. This dict was stored as delivery.address and later JSON-serialized to the frontend where React tried to render it as a child, throwing 'Objects are not valid as a React child'. The redemption branch used `ref.get('delivery_address') or ''` (correct) and pytest only tested that branch. Reproduction: create a cash withdrawal with details.address and call POST /api/admin/withdrawals/{id}/courier-fee -> query the resulting delivery -> address field is a dict. Mitigation applied: changed _ref_display to extract details.get('address') and details.get('province') defensively; existing broken docs must be migrated (one-liner script).
